subject: Gravitationally induced collapse variant (Penrose/Diósi-Grönblom family)

twelve_questions.1_physically_real: Wavefunction + gravitational degrees of freedom; collapse triggered by gravitational self-energy difference.
twelve_questions.2_primitive_variables: Mass density / quantum state + classical or semi-classical gravity field (varies by version).
twelve_questions.3_fundamental_dynamics: Unitary evolution PLUS deterministic stochastic collapse rate dependent on gravitational self-energy. OUTSIDE Cbp (Door D1: altered dynamics).
twelve_questions.4_probabilities_from: In Diósi's original proposal: from stochastic noise statistics (ASSUMED). The DP mechanism (Bassi et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 85, 471 (2013)) shows the originally claimed natural derivation was NOT established - the noise correlation must be specified by hand. This is the known weakness of the family.
twelve_questions.5_definite_outcomes: YES - collapse dynamics produces them (given the postulated noise).
twelve_questions.6_recovers_unitary_sector: YES in the weak-collapse limit (l_grav large).
twelve_questions.7_recovers_classicality: YES - via the same collapse dynamics.
twelve_questions.8_additional_inputs_beyond_Cbp: Gravitationally induced collapse rate/noise structure: ADDITIONAL_INPUT (ASSUMED). Collapse time scale and length scale (Diósi parameters) are empirical inputs.
twelve_questions.9_empirical_inputs: lambda_grav (rate), r_c / l_grav (length scale). Diósi-Penrose proposes lambda ~ 1/(hbar) * gravitational self-energy scale, but the stochastic-noise bridge (DP) requires an independent specification (Bassi et al. RMP 85, 471 (2013); Howl et al. 2018).
twelve_questions.10_novel_predictions: YES in principle - collapse noise correlates with gravitational coupling; distinguishable via interferometry at large masses (Howl et al. 2018: ~10^16 amu proposed discrimination; Kafexhiu-Donadi-Pikovski 2025: parameter-space collapse for a large l_grav class). EXPERIMENTAL FRONTIER - not yet decided.
twelve_questions.11_falsification: YES - mass interferometry and optomechanics bound l_grav/lambda; large regions already excluded for specific parameterizations (Carlesso et al.; Donadi et al. Nature Phys 17, 74 (2021): terrestrial test excluded Diósi-l_grav parameterization at the natural scale).
twelve_questions.12_unexplained_remainder: The stochastic noise specification is assumed, not derived from gravity itself; the mechanism does not derive Born weights from first principles either - it must reproduce them via the noise statistics, and the DP analysis shows this is NOT automatic.

outcome_probability_weights_supplied.note: (statistical reproduction, not derivation; DP obstruction recorded)

added_ontology.note: (gravitational field treated semi-classically in some versions)

scoring.compression: gain = 3.8; cost = 4.4; compression ~ 0.86. Best compression of any dynamical candidate ON PAPER, but carries the DP obstruction (probability structure not derived) and unconfirmed empirical status.

hypothesis_test: H1 ESCAPES (D1 door: altered dynamics). H2 OPEN - testable, not yet discriminated. H3 PASSES. H4: compression ratio competitive but not decisive. H5: does NOT preserve quantum linearity - collapses.
